name: kneeling reverse wrist rocks
description: A rocking forearm stretch with the palms down and fingers pointing back toward your knees. It lengthens the inside of the forearms and the front of the elbows.
instructions: Kneel on all fours and turn your hands so the fingers point back toward your knees.
Press your palms flat with your elbow creases facing forward.
Keep your arms straight and slowly sit your hips back toward your heels.
Stop when you feel a stretch along the inner forearms, then rock forward again.
Lift the heels of your hands if the stretch is too strong.
